tests.name: Legacy /providers URL redirects into Settings → AI

actions.comment: Replaces 'Providers Google card renders'. That test waited on `.prov-google-card`, a class that exists nowhere in the codebase any more: /providers is now a stub whose only job is to redirect to /settings?section=ai, and the Google connection UI moved to /mail/accounts. The Gmail reconnect affordance it was really guarding is covered by mail-reauth-banner.json (`.gmail-reauth-banner` on /mail), so what is left worth testing here is that the legacy URL still lands somewhere sane instead of dead-ending.

expect: Opening /providers does not dead-end: it redirects to /settings?section=ai, the unified AI section that superseded the old providers page.
